result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but the favorite (heart) button styling is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards, and one card's image treatment differs from its siblings.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' renders as a dark/black circle with a dark heart glyph, while the equivalent button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above is a white circle with a dark heart. The dark-on-dark version has very poor contrast and is hard to see or recognize as a tappable control.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent style to all favorite buttons (e.g. white/translucent circle with a dark or outlined heart) and ensure the icon meets contrast requirements over any image background.

issues.description: The heart icons act as toggle controls but have no visible label, and the low-contrast variant offers no accessible affordance; state (favorited vs not) is only conveyed by fill color.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g. 'Add to favorites') and ensure the selected state is distinguishable by more than color, with at least 3:1 contrast against the underlying image.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail uses a light grey background while the neighbouring cards use dark backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent and the white time badge on it slightly weaker.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail background treatment (or add a subtle overlay/scrim) so badges and imagery read consistently across all cards in the row.
